notes: two sayings: Sa'id's report about Ibn Umar's oil (saying 1), and Aisha's «كأني أنظر إلى وبيص الطيب» (saying 2)

the isnad of saying 2 is written only inside Ibrahim's reply («ما تصنع بقوله حدثني الأسود عن عائشة»); it does not say how that chain joins the Sufyan/Mansur route, so only الأسود and عائشة are written and the join is left open
«فذكرته لإبراهيم» : Ibrahim is in the scene and answers, but his words are a remark on the other isnad, so he is not a link of either saying
